data.name: ms2ap
data.value: At Socratic, we build a complete full-cycle ecosystem: from self-service smart kiosks and dynamic catalogs to inventory tracking, AI vision, and multi-currency payments. Our platform empowers modern businesses to streamline operations, delight customers, and accelerate growth.

data.name: ms3aul1
data.value: Universal Product & Service Catalog: Effortlessly manage goods, services, tickets, memberships, and rentals with real-time stock sync.

data.name: ms3aul2
data.value: Streamlined Order & Booking Management: From kiosk checkout to final fulfillment, track and update order states in real-time with zero friction.

data.name: ms3aul3
data.value: Customer Engagement & Face ID Loyalty: Enable instant client accounts, personalized favorites, fast checkout, and biometric recognition.

data.name: ms3aul4
data.value: Role-Based Access: Secure your platform by controlling who sees what. Different roles mean different access levels, keeping your data safe and operations smooth.

data.name: ms3aul5
data.value: Comprehensive Analytics: Gain actionable insights into sales, inventory turnover, customer preferences, and revenue drivers.

data.name: ms4aul1
data.value: User-Friendly Interface: Easy to navigate and designed for efficiency, our platform minimizes training time and maximizes productivity.

data.name: ms4aul2
data.value: Scalable Solutions: Whether a boutique store, service studio, or multi-location enterprise, Socratic scales seamlessly with your business.

data.name: ms4aul3
data.value: 24/7 Support: Our dedicated customer success team is here to support you around the clock, ensuring you get the most out of our platform.

data.name: Help_FaqKioskLaunchTitle
data.value: How to launch self-service kiosk mode?

data.name: Help_FaqKioskLaunchAnswer
data.value: To launch kiosk, go to /kiosk/{tenantId}. The kiosk automatically syncs the menu and connects the payment terminal.

data.name: Help_FaqOfflineTitle
data.value: Can the cash register work in offline mode without internet?

data.name: Help_FaqOfflineAnswer
data.value: Yes. Socratic uses a local database with Outbox Pattern background sync. The cashier continues issuing receipts when offline.

data.name: Help_FaqPaymentsTitle
data.value: What payment methods are supported out of the box?

data.name: Help_FaqPaymentsAnswer
data.value: The platform supports cash, bank cards via POS terminals (Humo, Uzcard, Visa, MasterCard), dynamic QR payments and bonus points.

data.name: Help_FaqDynamicQrTitle
data.value: How does dynamic QR work on customer display?

data.name: Help_FaqDynamicQrAnswer
data.value: When finalizing an order, a unique QR code is generated. Once scanned and paid in a mobile bank app, the receipt closes instantly.

data.name: Help_FaqHardwareAnswer
data.value: Hardware.Device module supports ESC/POS printers, 2D barcode scanners, scales and cash drawers.

data.name: Help_FaqHardwareStatusTitle
data.value: How to check hardware connection status?

data.name: Help_FaqHardwareStatusAnswer
data.value: Go to Hardware section (/hardware). The panel shows connection status of each device and diagnostics log.

data.name: Help_FaqAiTitle
data.value: How does face recognition and queue detection work?

data.name: Help_FaqAiAnswer
data.value: Intelligence module uses local YOLO and FaceNet networks. Video stream is processed in real time.
